info.description:
# Introduction

Travelport JSON API allows developers to quickly build solutions for searching and booking travel across the full range of Travelport supplier content for air, hotel, and car. JSON offers developers an off-the-shelf menu of APIs to create efficient, responsive travel applications.

# Overview

Requests are RESTful JSON.

# Authentication

Authentication with OAuth 2.0
